scope: Danish-language representations across the 69 logical English core sources. This index contains 23 accepted expansion representations and 42 prior official conversions whose live recheck failed; the prior status is preserved and this migration does not renew currentness. acceptance_scope: Representation states are recorded per entry. The 23 expansion representations retain their 2026 acceptance state. The 42 prior conversions retain their legacy live-recheck-failed state. This index does not certify legal force, currentness, full source coverage, topic coverage, or country completion.
